subject: perpetual interns
one_liner: A permanent home for your temporary role.
brand_voice_notes: Internal communications from a company that treats rolling internships as a retention programme. Calm, precise and professionally incurious about headcount. Seniority accrues in renewals. AI documents the absence of authority. No winks, no inspirational career language.

hero.h1: A permanent home for your temporary role.
hero.sub: Pending gives perpetual interns channels, voice rooms and AI-assigned seniority. Keep the same team through your next six onboarding cycles. Full-time employees appear in the directory as a courtesy.

features.title: Seniority without headcount
features.blurb: Our AI assigns a heavier title every two contract renewals, with Principal Incoming Intern at renewal six and higher grades from renewal eight. Your access to the printer stays pending.

features.title: A room for quick questions
features.blurb: Join the voice room and wait for someone authorised to answer. Pending records your waiting time as cross-functional exposure, even when nobody else joins.

features.title: Performance, back to onboarding
features.blurb: Paste a completed project. Our AI turns it into an onboarding task for your next contract, so your first week always starts with work you already know.

demo_screen_concept: A community messaging screen for the Long-Term Temporary server. A channel sidebar switches among quick-questions, introductions-again and conversion-watch. Messages show renewal counts and intern role badges. Users can send a message, search the current channel and switch channels. An AI handover action turns a submitted achievement into an onboarding task. A side panel shows contract renewals and a voice waiting room with a working join/leave button. Requesting a full-time role opens an accessible modal offering a clearly labelled contract renewal; accepting updates the renewal count, role and next-promotion hint, with visible confirmation. Titles advance every two renewals: Principal Incoming Intern at six, then higher principal grades at eight and every two renewals after. All state is mock and local.

design_direction.style: Flat industrial noticeboard. Oversized monospaced type, warm ochre signal fields, charcoal rails, rectangular joinery and administrative dividers. An outlined endless return-arrow graphic acts as the hero object. No gradients or floating glass cards.
design_direction.archetype: Community/Forum Landing from the bundled library, composed as an administrative noticeboard: statement hero, channel preview, three feature rows, member portraits and three subscription columns.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 150ms button colour changes and press translation. Demo status changes announce via live regions. Reduced motion removes transitions. No background motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Full-width ochre masthead. Oversized left-aligned mono headline with a dark rectangular CTA. Right-hand charcoal member pass shows a looping return arrow, cohort number and indefinite tenure. Cream lower page with a ruled channel-preview strip, ruled feature rows and a dark member testimonial section.

images.rationale: Hero skipped because the noticeboard direction uses a typographic statement and an HTML/SVG renewal pass. Demo subject assets skipped because the screen is text-based messaging, roles and a voice waiting room. Three testimonial portraits establish the long-serving intern cohort; the fourth slot is unused.

items.prompt: Deadpan corporate headshot, editorial photograph with flat direct flash and subtle film grain. One Latina woman in her late twenties, short dark bob, plain ochre shirt under a charcoal cardigan, plain blank lanyard with no badge, professionally neutral expression. Shoulders-up formal company directory composition, warm paper backdrop #F1EEE5, ochre #F2CE4B and carbon #232723 palette, industrial corporate noticeboard mood. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no rendered UI screens.
items.judge_verdict: Pass: correct subject, restrained corporate expression, matching paper/ochre/sage palette, no visible text artifacts or anatomical defects.
